naming: The loader builds its YamlDotNet IDeserializer with CamelCaseNamingConvention + IgnoreUnmatchedProperties. A C# PascalCase property binds to the camelCase YAML key. The 'direction' enum is parsed case-insensitively.

keys.description: The flow's unique identifier; seeds the stable FlowId. A blank value fails: "'name' is required for an sftp flow."
Optional grouping label recorded with the run.
Which way files move: down from the server into local (default), or up to the server from local.
The SFTP server and its credentials.
The SFTP host name or IP.
The SFTP port.
The SFTP username (a coordinate, not a secret).
A ${...} reference to the password; an alternative to server.privateKeyRef. One of the two is required.
A ${...} reference to the private-key PEM.
A ${...} reference to the passphrase protecting server.privateKeyRef.
The non-SFTP side: a data-lake URI (abfss://…/https) or a local/UNC path. On download it is the target; on upload it is the source. Managed-identity authenticated for Azure.
The directory on the SFTP server (the remote root). On download it is listed; on upload it is written to.
File-name glob selecting which files transfer.
Recurse into subdirectories under the root.
Only transfer files modified within this many days; 0 = all.
Overwrite an existing destination file; when false a collision fails rather than clobbers.

Optional explicit declaration of a single file set this download produces, for lineage. A download's output is 'local', so when neither output nor outputs is given lineage binds that single folder to the downstream ingestion. Declare an output to bind a specific landed folder/pattern to the ingestion(s) that read it. Applies to download; on upload the remote server is the output. Convenience for the one-folder case; use outputs for several.

The folder, full file path, or Azure/cloud URL this download lands. An Azure storage URI is canonicalized so its shape (abfss:// vs https .dfs) does not affect the lineage node; a local path is normalized against the estate root. Required when an output block is present.
The file-name glob within output.location (e.g. orders_*.json). Matched with FileSystemName; two wildcard patterns are tested for overlap. Quote a glob beginning with '*'.
An optional regex over the full landing path, applied symmetrically with a consumer's srcPathMask by FileSelection.Feeds, for cases the folder prefix cannot express. An invalid regex fails at parse.

Several file sets this download drops: one entry per (folder, pattern), each the same shape as output. FlowSetCollector registers the download as a file producer and reconciles each entry independently against every file ingestion with the shared engine-parity matcher (src/SqlFlow.Core/Files/FileSelection.cs), so an sftp download of several file sets connects to every consumer of those files; a drop nothing consumes still records its own file node. Many files in ONE folder need only a single entry with a glob, since the file node is the folder.
The folder, full file path, or Azure/cloud URL this drop lands at. Same normalization/canonicalization as output.location. Required for each entry.
The file-name glob within this drop's location; same semantics as output.srcFile.
An optional regex over this drop's full landing path; same semantics as output.srcPathMask.
